_note: Filled once for the whole company. VERIFY every value before the first product.

hosting.web: cloudflare-workers static assets (apps/web/out served by apps/api Worker)
hosting.api: cloudflare-workers (Hono), stateless for InvoiceKit: no D1/KV/R2
hosting.mobile: expo eas (free) or local gradle builds
hosting.platform: equisteg-platform Worker (shared payments/entitlement) via service binding

existingProducts.name: InvoiceKit
existingProducts.playUrl: <to be confirmed: app.invoicekit.android may already be on Play>
existingProducts.androidPackageNote: deviation from androidPackagePrefix com.equisteg: kept because changing a published package creates a new Play app (founder decision 29 Oct 2026)
existingProducts.domainRenewal: <to be confirmed> (auto-renew on, company Cloudflare account)

existingProducts.name: Finealth
existingProducts.domainNote: deviation from one-domain-per-product: a subdomain of teiqtools.com (founder decision 9 Nov 2026, RSK-010)
existingProducts.androidPackageNote: deviation from com.equisteg prefix: existing Capacitor app id kept (may already be on Play)

payments.web: razorpay (Equisteg is the seller, not a merchant of record: Equisteg issues GST invoices; Pro yearly = Razorpay subscription, lifetime = one-time order; test keys on dev/staging, live keys only in production after Gate 9)
payments.android: google-play-billing (subscription pro: base plans monthly + yearly; in-app product pro_lifetime), verified server-side with the Play Developer API
payments.signup: none — the device sends the licence key (Razorpay payment id pay_… or subscription id sub_…) or Play purchase token; the stateless Worker verifies it with the store and returns a 7-day Ed25519-signed token (packages/invoice-core/src/licence.ts)
payments.database: none — InvoiceKit stores no user data (no D1/KV/R2); the store is the only purchase record
payments.email: none (no magic links; restore = re-enter the licence key shown after checkout and on the Razorpay receipt, or Restore purchases on Play)
payments.note: InvoiceKit-specific; other products follow phase 04b (D1 entitlements) unless a founder decides otherwise

costPolicy: zero-cost: free tiers or open source only; see docs/standards/zero-cost.md

domains.pattern: each product has its own domain (apex, www redirects); dev/staging on *.workers.dev
domains.registrar: Cloudflare Registrar in the company (Equisteg) account, registrant org Equisteg, auto-renew on — bought by a founder
domains.emailFrom: no-reply@equisteg.com via Resend (free plan verifies 3 domains — never one per product)
domains.supportEmail: support@<domain> via Cloudflare Email Routing → developerEmail
domains.attribution: own product name/logo + 'A product by Equisteg' (footer, About, app About); Equisteg is the legal entity and JSON-LD publisher
